name: mediaproc
description: Media processing over SSH — ffmpeg, sox, and ImageMagick for video/audio transcoding and image manipulation inside a locked-down lockbox container

host.title: mediaproc host
host.description: Hostname or IP of your running mediaproc instance (MEDIAPROC_HOST). Only point this at an instance you or a trusted operator controls — whoever runs it sees every file transferred through it.

port.title: mediaproc SSH port
port.description: SSH port of the mediaproc instance (MEDIAPROC_PORT).
